methodology_note: Every output below was read and judged by hand against the real base resume and real profile.json evidence (Phase 3 of the spec) -- NOT scored by ApplyPilot's production validator. A finding is tagged 'model' (genuine model-quality failure: invented fact/employer/title/date/skill not present anywhere in the resume, or echoed prompt scaffolding as content) or 'integration' (would have been fine or is a formatting/parsing nuisance, not a truthfulness issue) per the user's explicit instruction not to collapse those two categories.
known_harness_bug_corrected: qwen3:1.7b's first pass returned EMPTY output on 4 of 7 configs (Ollama's 'thinking' mode was silently consuming the entire num_predict budget before any visible answer was produced). Confirmed via a targeted retest with think:false, then the full qwen3 sweep was re-run with think:false. All qwen3 results below are from the corrected run. This was an integration bug in this experiment's harness, not a qwen3 capability finding -- called out explicitly per the 'don't collapse model failure with representation failure' instruction.
